item.title: Senators Olympic tracker: Stutzle's offensive mastery leads Germany to quarterfinal berth
item.description: Tim Stutzle added another two points as Germany defeated France 5-1 to move on in the medal round, and Lars Eller had another tough game in Denmark's 3-2 loss to Czechia in a qualification playoff.

item.title: 21 Ottawa restaurants with special meals and extended hours for Ramadan
item.description: Serving sumptuous buffets and discounted meals during special hours, these Ottawa restaurants will help Muslims break their Ramadan fasts.

item.title: Quebec safety agency identified 'non-conformities' at Vorlage after fatal accident
item.description: Centre Vorlage, the ski area near Wakefield, was prohibited from operating its aerial lifts while a review was underway following the death of a 13-year-old Ottawa girl

item.title: ‘Don’t let me down, sir‘: Judge gives man no prison time in ‘mercy killing’ of husband
item.description: The conditional sentence was less than the two years sought by the defence. The Crown had wanted six years jail time.

item.title: Five Ottawa Charge players set to compete for an Olympic gold medal
item.description: Three Canadians and two Americans from the Ottawa Charge will compete for the Olympic gold medal in women's hockey on Thursday.

item.title: 'The guy is unbelievable': Senators amazed by Tim Stutzle's dominance at Winter Olympics
item.description: On the first day back at practice post-Olympic break, Senators players Thomas Chabot, Shane Pinto and Drake Batherson spoke about their teammates' performances for their respective countries at Milan-Cortina.

item.title: Two men face drug charges after Ottawa police investigation
item.description: Police said they seized "various quantities of drugs including cocaine, oxycodone pills, MDMA, and crack cocaine, as well as a significant amount of Canadian currency."

item.title: Ottawa man faces charges after attempted bank robbery, Ottawa police say
item.description: The attempted bank robbery took place Oct. 21, 2025 in the 1900 block of St. Laurent Boulevard, Ottawa police said
